description: FPE (Fact Percentage Analysis) Index Analysis is a fact-based methodology for analyzing business efficiency. The analysis compares three correlated business measures: Fixed Costs, Variable Costs, and Revenues, plus the total of these measures as the denominator of the Efficiency Index. Companies and Consultant Professional can compare the performances of a Company or single Business Units compared with Competitors or over time. It addresses the need to understand and monitor the efficency performance positioning on the FPE Index methodology.
